encodes quantum gauge symmetry. \\ Residual quantum transfer & After quantum consistency is restored, transfer the correction to the smaller complex that represents the surviving physical content. \\ Reconstruction/limits & Connect the formulation back to operational predictions, a continuum or standard theory, or a demonstrated notion of empirical equivalence. \\

Candidate selectors include a Hamiltonian ground condition, KMS condition, incoming detector preparation, residual symmetry, or a local Hadamard condition. A no-selection theorem is valuable only when its symmetry and state class are physically justified.
